description: This file defines an abstract class RtNotifier with pure virtual methods related to handling notifications for Xcast applications, including launch, stop, hide, resume, and state requests, as well as service disconnection.

classes.name: RtNotifier
classes.description: An abstract class for notification callbacks related to Xcast applications.

methods.name: onRtServiceDisconnected
methods.description: Callback for when the RT service gets disconnected.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationLaunchRequest
methods.description: Handles a request to launch an Xcast application with the specified application name and parameters.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationLaunchRequestWithLaunchParam
methods.description: Handles a launch request with additional payload, query parameters, and extra data URL.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationStopRequest
methods.description: Handles a request to stop an Xcast application.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationHideRequest
methods.description: Handles a request to hide an Xcast application.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationResumeRequest
methods.description: Handles a request to resume an Xcast application.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationStateRequest
methods.description: Handles a request to query the state of an Xcast application.
